data.content_ref: inline:Integrates with the RESIDUE and standing-residue annotations: suspend_reason shares the same post-fixpoint annotation mechanism (pure function of final grounded labels and attack graph) and reduces to a local causal classification of suspension; it is compatible with the bounded-BFS standing-residue overlay, with standing residue refining insufficient_defense when no accepted defender is within k. Refuted if there is any grounded extension in which suspend_reason and RESIDUE assign different causal explanations to the same suspended node without an attack-graph difference, or if the standing-residue BFS requires a second fixpoint or changes accepted/refuted/suspended labels.
